lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed as four distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters. The primary mid-flank row contains approximately seven clearly defined nodes spaced at regular intervals between the pectoral fin base and the posterior image boundary.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, with high-luminance blobs positioned as anchor nodes at these intersections, creating a visible rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to deep-shadow lower regions, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of significantly smaller, lower-intensity spots compared to the larger, more organized nodes on the primary flank.
